snippet.title: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition - The Three Kingdoms [STEAM]
snippet.description:
Dive into the legendary tale of The Three Kingdoms in the latest Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition expansion, where history and myth collide.

Lead three new civilizations—Shu, Wei, and Wu—each with unique playstyles, legendary leaders, and powerful units. 

With new strategies, epic heroes, and dynamic storytelling, The Three Kingdoms expansion transforms Age of Empires II into an unforgettable journey through China’s legendary past. Will you unite an empire or fade into history? 

*The Three Kingdoms expansion included with purchase of Premium Edition game. Separate purchase required with Standard Edition.

Audio Description: https://youtu.be/ph6XrRz5RcI
